+ /**
+  * Langbase AI Agent service
+  *
+  * This service provides a wrapper around the Langbase AI API for the FLS website agent.
+  */
+ 
+ // Type definitions
+ export interface LangbaseAgentRequest {
+ 	input: string;
+ 	options?: Record<string, any>;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface LangbaseAgentResponse {
+ 	output: string;
+ 	[key: string]: any; // For additional fields in the response
+ }
+ 
+ export const LANGBASE_API_ENDPOINT =
+ 	"https://api.langbase.com/monichre/fls-website-agent";
+ export const LANGBASE_AUTH_TOKEN =
+ 	"user_j1kyyhtUKA1S71EG8HTM7th9mX9CLC3G9fH8HFvRrWrVh5WEAXJ1pJDX1fEH1MWHUdHavb6PMVjiX1ZVpqQU36d";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Calls the Langbase AI agent with the provided input
+  *
+  * @param input - The user input to send to the agent
+  * @param options - Optional parameters to customize the agent behavior
+  * @returns The response from the Langbase AI agent
+  */
+ export async function callLangbaseAgent(
+ 	input: string,
+ 	options?: Record<string, any>,
+ ): Promise<LangbaseAgentResponse> {
+ 	try {
+ 		const response = await fetch(LANGBASE_API_ENDPOINT, {
+ 			method: "POST",
+ 			headers: {
+ 				Authorization: `Bearer ${LANGBASE_AUTH_TOKEN}`,
+ 				"Content-Type": "application/json",
+ 			},
+ 			body: JSON.stringify({
+ 				input,
+ 				...options,
+ 			}),
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		if (!response.ok) {
+ 			const errorText = await response.text();
+ 			throw new Error(
+ 				`Langbase API error (${response.status}): ${errorText || response.statusText}`,
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const data = await response.json();
+ 		return data as LangbaseAgentResponse;
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error calling Langbase agent:", error);
+ 		throw error instanceof Error
+ 			? error
+ 			: new Error("Unknown error occurred while calling Langbase agent");
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
```

Now let's create our Langbase agent hook:

---

```diff

+ "use client";
+ 
+ import { useState } from "react";
+ import {
+ 	callLangbaseAgent,
+ 	LangbaseAgentResponse,
+ } from "../lib/api/langbase-agent";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook for interacting with the Langbase AI agent
+  */
+ export function useLangbaseAgent() {
+ 	const [response, setResponse] = useState<LangbaseAgentResponse | null>(null);
+ 	const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
+ 	const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
+ 
+ 	/**
+ 	 * Send a message to the Langbase AI agent
+ 	 *
+ 	 * @param input - The user input to send to the agent
+ 	 * @param options - Optional parameters for the agent
+ 	 */
+ 	const sendMessage = async (input: string, options?: Record<string, any>) => {
+ 		setIsLoading(true);
+ 		setError(null);
+ 
+ 		try {
+ 			const result = await callLangbaseAgent(input, options);
+ 			setResponse(result);
+ 			return result;
+ 		} catch (err) {
+ 			const error =
+ 				err instanceof Error ? err : new Error("Unknown error occurred");
+ 			setError(error);
+ 			return null;
+ 		} finally {
+ 			setIsLoading(false);
+ 		}
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	/**
+ 	 * Clear the current response and error state
+ 	 */
+ 	const clearResponse = () => {
+ 		setResponse(null);
+ 		setError(null);
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		sendMessage,
+ 		clearResponse,
+ 		response,
+ 		isLoading,
+ 		error,
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
```

+           {isLoading ? 'Sending...' : buttonText}

Now, let's create a documentation file for the Langbase Agent service:

---

```diff
- 
+ # Langbase AI Agent
+ 
+ This document explains how to use the Langbase AI Agent service in the FLS website project.
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ The Langbase AI Agent allows you to integrate an AI assistant into your website that can answer questions about FLS products and services. This implementation provides:
+ 
+ - A TypeScript service to handle API calls to Langbase
+ - A React hook for easy integration into components
+ - A ready-to-use chat component
+ 
+ ## Service Architecture
+ 
+ The implementation includes:
+ 
+ 1. Core API service (`src/lib/api/langbase-agent.ts`)
+ 2. React hook for state management (`src/hooks/useLangbaseAgent.ts`)
+ 3. UI component (`src/components/langbase-agent/LangbaseChat.tsx`)
+ 
+ ## Usage Examples
+ 
+ ### Basic API Call
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ import { callLangbaseAgent } from '@/lib/api/langbase-agent';
+ 
+ // In a server component or API route
+ export async function GET() {
+   try {
+     const result = await callLangbaseAgent('Tell me about FLS products');
+     return Response.json(result);
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error:', error);
+     return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to connect to Langbase' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Using the React Hook
+ 
+ ```tsx
+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import { useLangbaseAgent } from '@/hooks';
+ 
+ export default function MyComponent() {
+   const { sendMessage, response, isLoading, error } = useLangbaseAgent();
+   
+   const handleClick = async () => {
+     await sendMessage('Tell me about FLS products');
+   };
+   
+   return (
+     <div>
+       <button onClick={handleClick} disabled={isLoading}>
+         Ask about products
+       </button>
+       
+       {isLoading && <p>Loading...</p>}
+       {error && <p>Error: {error.message}</p>}
+       {response && <div>{response.output}</div>}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Using the Chat Component
+ 
+ ```tsx
+ import { LangbaseChat } from '@/components/langbase-agent';
+ 
+ export default function AIChatPage() {
+   return (
+     <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
+       <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Chat with our AI Assistant</h1>
+       <LangbaseChat
+         placeholder="Ask about our products..."
+         buttonText="Send Message"
+         className="mx-auto"
+       />
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Configuration
+ 
+ The Langbase API endpoint and authentication token are stored as constants in `src/lib/api/langbase-agent.ts`. For production environments, consider moving these values to environment variables.
+ 
+ ## Security Considerations
+ 
+ - The authentication token is currently hardcoded in the service file. In a production environment, this should be moved to a server-side environment variable to prevent exposure in client-side code.
+ - Consider implementing rate limiting to prevent abuse of the API.
+ 
+ ## Future Improvements
+ 
+ - Add streaming response support when Langbase provides it
+ - Implement conversation history
+ - Add typing indicators and other UX improvements
+ - Create a more comprehensive chat interface with message history 
```

Now, let's create a floating chat popup component:

---

```diff
- 
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState, useEffect} from 'react'
+ import {motion, AnimatePresence} from 'framer-motion'
+ import {LangbaseChat} from './LangbaseChat'
+ import {MessageCircle, X} from 'lucide-react'
+ 
+ export interface FloatingChatProps {
+   buttonLabel?: string
+   initialMessage?: string
+   mobile?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ export function FloatingChat({
+   buttonLabel = 'Chat with us',
+   initialMessage = 'Hi there! How can I help you today?',
+   mobile = false,
+ }: FloatingChatProps) {
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
+   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
+ 
+   // Wait for client-side hydration
+   useEffect(() => {
+     setMounted(true)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const toggleChat = () => {
+     setIsOpen(!isOpen)
+   }
+ 
+   if (!mounted) return null
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className='fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50'>
+       <AnimatePresence mode='wait'>
+         {isOpen ? (
+           <motion.div
+             key='chat-window'
+             initial={{opacity: 0, y: 50, scale: 0.9}}
+             animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1}}
+             exit={{opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.9}}
+             transition={{duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut'}}
+             className='bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden'
+           >
+             <div className='bg-blue-600 text-white p-3 flex justify-between items-center'>
+               <h3 className='font-medium'>FLS Assistant</h3>
+               <button
+                 onClick={toggleChat}
+                 className='text-white hover:bg-blue-700 rounded-full p-1 transition-colors'
+                 aria-label='Close chat'
+               >
+                 <X size={18} />
+               </button>
+             </div>
+             <div className='p-4'>
+               <LangbaseChat
+                 placeholder='Ask about our products...'
+                 buttonText='Send'
+               />
+             </div>
+           </motion.div>
+         ) : (
+           <motion.button
+             key='chat-button'
+             onClick={toggleChat}
+             initial={{opacity: 0, scale: 0.8}}
+             animate={{opacity: 1, scale: 1}}
+             exit={{opacity: 0, scale: 0.8}}
+             whileHover={{scale: 1.05}}
+             whileTap={{scale: 0.95}}
+             className='bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-full p-3 shadow-lg flex items-center'
+             aria-label={buttonLabel}
+           >
+             <MessageCircle size={24} className='mr-2' />
+             <span className='font-medium'>{buttonLabel}</span>
+           </motion.button>
+         )}
+       </AnimatePresence>
+     </div>
+   )
+ }
+ 
```
